description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog for managing and inserting templates within the editor. It includes functions for rendering template lists, creating template items, inserting templates into the editor, and handling keyboard navigation.

methods.name: renderTemplatesList
methods.description: Constructs the HTML view of the specified templates data and appends template items to the container.

methods.name: createTemplateItem
methods.description: Creates a DOM element representing a template, including its preview and description, and sets up click event to insert the template.

methods.name: insertTemplate
methods.description: Inserts the selected template HTML into the editor, either replacing content or inserting at cursor position based on user choice.

methods.name: keyNavigation
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the template list, allowing arrow keys and enter/space for selection.
